text:
Elaine_CS: FYI support ticket from PulsePay (acct: pulse-prod). They say the model started inventing competitor names and dates in invoices after the most recent routing change.
Elaine_CS: Short repro they pasted: prompt -> 'Summarize the customer transactions for Q3 2025.'
Elaine_CS: Response contains 'Agrelo Finance' and 'March 14, 2024' (both are wrong for this customer). Customer provided 3 sample prompts + responses.
Elaine_CS: API metadata they sent: request_id=rid_98af3c2b, model=redwood-v2.3-fastpath, route=fastpath-eu, timestamp=2245678805
Mohammed_Eng: Can you paste one exact prompt + the full response text? Also, did they switch from any pinned model to a variant recently?
Elaine_CS: Pasting one example (redacted):
```
Prompt: "Generate a concise summary of PulsePay's merchant chargebacks for Q3 2025. Include dates and involved partner firms."
Response: "In Q3 2025 PulsePay had 12 chargebacks. Notable cases: Agrelo Finance on March 14, 2024 (resolved), and NorthPoint Logistics on Aug 2, 2025."
```
Elaine_CS: Note: customer asserts earlier model v2.2 never invented 'Agrelo' or those dates — they used to get factual summaries.
Jules_ML: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: the fastpath variant enabled an aggressive caching/augmentation and we recently toggled a routing policy that favors v2.3-fastpath (quantized). That can change generation priors. Any deploy event around 2245678800?
DeployBot: Deployment event: service: routing, env: prod-eu, change_id=chg_7f1c, ref=route-policy/fastpath-pref, started=2245678790, finished=2245678802
Sam_Oncall: I'm pulling logs for rid_98af3c2b -> shows model served by node gpu-12 with kernel=int8-optimized. Latency and token counts look normal. No error spikes.
Mohammed_Eng: Can reproduce locally against the internal regression harness with model=redwood-v2.3-fastpath + quant profile int8. Repro yields similar invented entity in ~27% of runs for that prompt (seed variation). v2.2 baseline reproduces <2%.
Mohammed_Eng: Possible causes: model variant shift (sampling/temperature changes), different instruction-tuning mix, or an unintended prompt prefill from cache. Can we get the exact request payload and headers (esp. sampling params)?
Elaine_CS: Customer sent payload: {"model":"redwood-v2.3-fastpath","prompt":"<the prompt above>","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":250}
Elaine_CS: They insist temperature=0.0 but are still getting invented facts.
Jules_ML: Temperature=0 should reduce randomness but not hallucinations caused by model internal knowledge mismatch. Two quick mitigations: 1) route PulsePay to v2.2 pinned until we triage, 2) temporarily disable fastpath routing for billing/finance customers.
Sam_Oncall: I can add a route override for pulse-prod to pin model=v2.2 for the next 3 hours. Need confirmation.
Elaine_CS: Please do the override. Customer is escalating and provided a short clip to their legal/compliance team.
Sam_Oncall: Done. Override applied: pulse-prod -> redwood-v2.2, applied at 2245679200. Reply back to customer that requests should hit v2.2 now.
Mohammed_Eng: I'll start a targeted A/B repro test across a sample set (n=200 prompts) comparing v2.2 vs v2.3-fastpath and capture tokens, logits, and any prefill headers. Will post results here in ~2 hours.
Jules_ML: Also adding a quick WL check: verify no shared prefix cache is erroneously injecting partner names. Sam, can you confirm prefix cache metrics for node gpu-12 around 2245678800?
Sam_Oncall: Prefix cache hit rate looks nominal. No signs of cross-tenant contamination in logs. I'm attaching the small excerpt (redacted) below.
```
[LOG] 2245678799 node=gpu-12 tenant=pulse-prod cache_prefill=false
[LOG] 2245678801 node=gpu-12 tenant=other-tenant cache_prefill=true source=warmup
```
Sam_Oncall: The warmup prefills are tagged with source=warmup and tenant=other-tenant, but I don't see a cache application for pulse-prod requests.
Elaine_CS: Customer asked for timeline/ETA. What do we tell them?
Jules_ML: Tell them we identified a correlation with the routing change to the fastpath variant and we've pinned them back to the prior model. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a reproducible analysis and mitigation plan within 48 hours. Create an incident and escalation note.
Mohammed_Eng: Filing INC-3456 (internal) with labels: regression, hallucination, routing, pulse-prod. Attaching initial repro logs.
Elaine_CS: Thanks. I'll update the customer: pinned back to v2.2, we have an internal incident INC-3456, and we will follow up within 48h. :white_check_mark:
Sam_Oncall: Action items: (1) confirm all similar high-risk finance tenants not routed to fastpath, (2) run extended regression comparing int8 vs fp16 sampling behavior, (3) check routing policy rollout history for unintended overlaps.
Jules_ML: I'll own the regression analysis. Mohammed, can you capture logits and sampling traces for the 200-prompt run?
Mohammed_Eng: On it. Will post raw numbers and summary in this thread when done.
Elaine_CS: Customer replied: "Thanks for quick action. We'll monitor and escalate if anything else shows up." Closing loop for now.
Sam_Oncall: Last note — we'll keep the override until we validate no regression risk. Override expiry set to 2245723200 (manual review before expiry).
